findings.note: Segment label 所有沿用默认设置的会话 is 12 CJK chars (24 cells) next to 此会话; correct meaning (fixes old 后续 misreading) but wide for a PickerSegment; optional shorter 沿用默认的会话. No maxCells hint, so not gating.
Second sentence adds 也 (它也沿用该设置) that English lacks; harmless. Optional: 除非此会话自行选择，否则沿用该设置。
